description: Post a public comment on a post, or a reply to a top-level comment, under the user's own name. Other people see it, and anyone @mentioned is notified, so show the user the exact text and get their go-ahead first. Plain text, 1–2,200 characters; replies go one level deep. Fails with 403 when the author turned comments off.

parent_id.description: Optional: the top-level comment UUID to reply to

post_id.description: Post UUID (from get_feed, list_posts or list_tag_posts)

name: create_comment
